Sell this by 5 April each financial year to realise your profits (hopefully) and if the amount invested is circa 20k your gain should sit below the 3k capital gains tax you are allowed tax free. Dividends may be close to the £500 mark however - you pay tax beyond this. It's best using a distribution fund for this and do not reinvest dividends during the year - this provides an audit trail should HMRC come calling. Of course this only works if you aren't using your CGT allowance elsewhere and remember all sales during the financial year count towards your allowance. And you only get to use 3k in that year, it's not carried forward. If the investment is down don't sell. This way you invest around 40k tax free per annum. Not financial advice, just a useful tip 😊
